title: feat(console): Change Owner's queue picker searches the server; a non-grid list says bulk Change Owner is in the grid
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDHJBvzScLgkhKgms97sNuU)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhoBbwh8URjwQHde8v

Fixes #36395
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：控制台「更改负责人」对话框里，选「队列」时改为可输入搜索的选择器，任何一个队列都能找到并选中（此前超过两百个的选不到）；能转交记录的用户在看板、日历、画廊等视图顶部会看到一行提示：批量更改负责人请切换到表格视图。
- 为什么做：属于「负责人」专题，替队列很多的组织解决选不到队列的问题，并让看板用户知道批量更改负责人在哪里。
- 出错会怎样：改给队列时可能选不到队列，或提示在不该出现的视图里出现；直接撤回本改动即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

- **Queue tab (item 2).** The Change Owner dialog's queue target used to read `sys_queue` once with `$top: 200` into a plain dropdown with no search. An organization with more than 200 queues could not pick the rest. The queue tab now uses the shared lookup widget the person tab uses (`UserField` delegates to `LookupField`), pointed at `sys_queue`: `idField: 'name'`, `displayField: 'label'`, `allowCreate: false`. It reads one page at a time, only when the picker opens, and sends the typed term to the server as `$search`. It commits the queue's `name`, which is what the endpoint's `queue` takes. The 200-row read, the `QueueState` machine and its four text states are removed; the lookup widget draws its own loading, empty and error states.
- **Item 1: bulk Change Owner is grid-only, and a non-grid list says so.** Measured on `origin/main` at 844218f5: kanban, gallery and calendar hold no multi-row selection, and neither do timeline, gantt, map or tree. `plugin-kanban/src`, `ObjectGallery.tsx`, `plugin-calendar/src` and the other view plugins have no selection model. The seat chose option B: a one-line muted note in `ObjectView` (app-shell), drawn above the list on those seven layouts when two things hold. The object offers Change Owner (`bulkChangeOwnerReachable`, the same structural reach the grid's bulk entry uses), and the object-level transfer verdict allows it (`useListChangeOwnerOffered`, asked only while such a layout is on screen). The layout read is the reader's unsaved layout first, as the list draws it (`listDraft.draft.viewType ?? activeView.type`). A grid, or an unknown type the list draws as a grid, shows no note and asks nothing on open. Wording: en "To change the owner of several records at once, switch to a grid view.", zh-Hans 「如需一次更改多条记录的负责人，请切换到表格视图。」. The nine other packs carry translations, per the full key-parity rule. `ListView.onBulkChangeOwner` and the `objectViewListRenderer` prop doc say the same.
- **Orphaned keys removed.** The four `console.changeOwner.*` keys the queue tab no longer reads (`noClient`, `queuesLoading`, `queuesFailed`, `noQueues`) are deleted from all 11 packs; `console.changeOwner.gridOnly` is added to all 11.
- One changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell: patch`).

Files to read first (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ChangeOwnerDialog.tsx`: the `queueField` memo and the `LookupWidget` replacing the `Select`. Risk hunk: the `onChange` keeps only a string value.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`: `LAYOUTS_WITHOUT_BULK_SELECTION` and the `bulkChangeOwnerGridOnly` gate. Risk: a layout list that drifts from `ListView`'s switch.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/changeOwner-35403.test.tsx`: the harness mock now passes the real `lookup` widget through and stubs every other type.

Two-minute check: run `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/changeOwner-35403.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.bulkChangeOwnerReach-35403.test.tsx`. Expect all passed, with the #36395 describes among them.

## Tests

- New top-level describe in the shared harness (`changeOwner-35403.test.tsx`), with a `sys_queue` backend of **201 queues** that honours `$search`/`$filter`/`$top`/`$skip`:
  - "reads nothing until the queue picker opens"
  - "a list: the 201st queue, past any first page, is found by a server search and picked" asserts that the first page lacks Queue 201, that a `$search: 'Queue 201'` read happened, and that `changeOwnerMany('crm_case', ['c1','c2'], { queue: 'queue_201' })` was called.
  - "one record: the searched queue is sent by its name" asserts `changeOwner('crm_case', 'c1', { queue: 'queue_201' })`.
- The old Select-based queue case, which pinned `find('sys_queue', { $top: 200 })`, is replaced by the above.
- Two existing layout-draft suites now serve the transfer verdict a board asks for the note. `ObjectView.sharedViewSave-35955` installs a module-scope `fetch` double that answers it, because a socket escape was red in CI. `ObjectView.kanbanSaveAs-36370` stops counting that POST, a read, as a write.
- Merged `origin/main` after #36525 landed. `ChangeOwnerDialog.tsx` keeps its cascade ticks, `RunState` and report lines; the queue tab's lookup replaces the old capped read. Each locale pack keeps #36525's cascade keys, drops the four orphaned keys, and adds `gridOnly`.
- New top-level describe in the `ObjectView` bulk-reach harness: on a kanban with Change Owner offered and the transfer verdict allowing it, the note is drawn with the en wording, and the verdict was asked once at object grain. On a kanban with the verdict refused, no note. On a grid with the verdict allowing it, no note and nothing asked on open. CONTROL: on a kanban of an object that does not offer Change Owner, no note and nothing asked.

## Acceptance notes

- Declared queues are not offered (class a candidate, reach NOT MEASURED; the seat files it). Before and after this PR, the Change Owner queue picker reads only `sys_queue` rows. Package-declared queues (the `queue` metadata type, ADR-0142 D1/D7) never appear, although the other queue pickers merge both sources through `mergeQueueCandidates` (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/queueCandidates.ts`). No app in the repo declares a queue yet (`examples/app-showcase/src/coverage.ts`).
- The note's layout list is a local set in `ObjectView`, the seven non-grid record layouts `ListView` switches on. `chart` and `timesheet` are left out: neither shows records as items.
- The nine non-English, non-zh-Hans translations are mine, written to each pack's existing Change Owner and grid wording; a native reviewer may refine them.

## Verification

<details><summary>Focused test file (lock VERDICT command-exit 0)</summary>

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  32 passed (32)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Reverse check: base dialog restored, tests red (lock VERDICT command-exit 1)</summary>

The fix was committed first. `ChangeOwnerDialog.tsx` was restored from 844218f5 (on-disk hash `3c457dc7` = the base blob) and the file run again:

```
     × reads nothing until the queue picker opens
     × a list: the 201st queue, past any first page, is found by a server search and picked
     × one record: the searched queue is sent by its name, never its row id or label
      Tests  3 failed | 29 passed (32)
```

The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; its hash is back to the HEAD blob `321811f6`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the layout gate removed, the grid pins red</summary>

Run with `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --anchor 'bulkChangeOwnerReachable && LAYOUTS_WITHOUT_BULK_SELECTION.has(listLayoutType),' --replacement 'bulkChangeOwnerReachable,'`. The anchor went 1 to 0 and the blob changed (ba95ee17 to 3467daa3), so the mutation landed:

```
     × transfer, no delete, no authored bulk actions: checkboxes on open with no request; ...
     × a grid, with the transfer verdict allowing it: no note, and nothing asked on open
      Tests  2 failed | 5 passed (7)
```

Restored: blob == HEAD (ba95ee17), `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

Local gate readings and the type-check follow in the os-dev-report comment, at the final head.
